passage.title: Ember and the Rain Clouds
passage.text:
High above the hills there is a castle made of clouds, where a little dragon called Ember lives. Ember's job is very important: she helps make the rain.

Every morning, the warm sun heats the water in the seas, lakes and rivers. Some of the water turns into a gas called water vapour and rises up into the sky. This is called evaporation.

High in the sky the air is cold, so the water vapour cools down and turns back into tiny drops of water. Millions of drops gather together to make a cloud. When the drops get big and heavy, they fall as rain, and the rain flows back into the rivers and the sea. Then it all happens again!

But one day, Ember sneezed a giant sneeze, and the castle's cloud machine went quiet. “Oh no,” she said. “Without rain, the gardens down below will dry up!”

mission.title: The Quiet Cloud Machine
mission.goal: Restart the cloud machine and find the Dream Key piece!

intro.line: Achoo! Oh, hello, Sparky. I sneezed so hard that the castle's cloud machine stopped!
The restart lever is at the top of the castle, and a piece of the Dream Key is hidden there too.
Let's climb the Cloud Castle and get the rain going again!
First, read my story on the Story Stone, so you know how rain is made.

beats.setup: Tweet! I'm Puff, a little cloud bird. Listen to my message, and I'll show you the way up!
beats.success: Tweet tweet! That's right! Follow me!
beats.fail: Tweet? That's not what I said! Listen again.

beats.setup: The castle signpost blew round in my sneeze. Answer a question about my story to fix it.
beats.success: The sign points to the tower now!
beats.fail: Oh no, it's still spinning. Let's read my story again.
beats.clue: The sign points up the tower

beats.setup: Grr... I'm Gargle, guardian of the castle gate. Tell me what my cloud words mean and I'll let you pass.
beats.success: Hmm, very clever. The gate is open.
beats.fail: Grr, not quite. The gate stays shut.

beats.setup: The rainbow bridge lost some of its steps! Count them with me and we'll fix it.
beats.success: The rainbow bridge is fixed! Across we go!
beats.fail: Oops, the steps drifted away. Let's count again.

beats.setup: This beanstalk ladder needs to grow. Use your science brain to help it!
beats.success: Splendid! It's growing tall and green!
beats.fail: Hmm, it's still small. Think again.
beats.clue: The beanstalk grew up to the tower

beats.setup: The tower chest has a pattern lock. Work out what comes next to open it.
beats.success: Click! A clue: the lever is under the big X!
beats.fail: Clunk. Still locked. Look at the pattern again.
beats.clue: The lever is under the big X

beats.setup: The machine room needs a password. Listen carefully and write it!
beats.success: The machine room is open! The lever is just ahead!
beats.fail: That's not the password. Let's try again.

finale.line: There's the X! Pull the lever... and dig, Sparky, dig!
The rain is falling on the gardens! And here's a piece of the Dream Key!
Splendid work! Take it back to Dreamforge, and the dreams will come alive.
